decisive_items: 4 symmetric concentric ring-shaped opacities in posterior corneal stroma
long bandlike structures with thin streaks of white lines interspersed
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has the most specific and detailed support from the vignette, including the description of ring-shaped opacities and bandlike structures on confocal microscopy, which are characteristic of corneal amyloidosis. R1 is the runner-up because it also has some supporting evidence, but it is less specific and detailed than R3.

rejected.why: R5 is rejected because the presence of posterior crocodile shagreen is not sufficient to diagnose crocodile shagreen of the cornea, and the vignette does not provide enough information to support this diagnosis.
R2 is rejected because the normal serum iron levels contradict the diagnosis of corneal iron deposition.
